result:
The profile settings page now has an **Account activity** card, placed between Security and Delete Account. It shows when the account was created, when the user last logged in, and a **Download my data** button. As you asked, I did not run tests, lint or the app, so none of this has been checked yet.

**I did not add a new endpoint.** `apps/web/AGENTS.md` bans new server actions and says new backend work should be an `/api/v3` route. I avoided both. The page loads the user's memberships along with the data it already fetches, and the browser builds the JSON file. This keeps it to one small query and adds no API surface. The file is built from the data on the page when it loaded, so a change made in another tab only shows up after a reload. If you would prefer a session-only `/api/v3` export endpoint used through TanStack Query, I can switch to that, but it also needs an OpenAPI spec entry and contract coverage.

**What changed** (most files are under `apps/web/app/(app)/workspaces/[workspaceId]/settings/account/profile/`):
- **`lib/user.ts`**: new `getUserOrganizationMemberships(userId)`. It is one query that gets each organization's name and the user's role, sorted by name. The user id comes from the session, so users can only read their own memberships.
- **`lib/account-data-export.ts`**: `buildAccountDataExport` builds the file from a fixed list of fields: name, email, locale, notification settings, and memberships (organization name and role). A field added to the user model later will not end up in the file by accident.
- **`lib/account-data-export.test.ts`**: unit tests that check the export holds exactly those fields.
- **`components/AccountActivity.tsx`**: shows the two dates and the download button. The button saves `formbricks-my-data.json` using the existing `saveBlobAsFile` helper.
- **`apps/web/app/(app)/account/settings/profile/page.tsx`**: adds the card. The membership query runs in parallel with the page's other two user lookups.
- **`apps/web/locales/en-US.json`**: 6 new keys under `workspace.settings.profile`.

**Dates:** they are formatted in the user's own language. Users have no saved time zone, so times are shown in UTC with a "UTC" label. If the user has never logged in, the card shows "Not recorded yet".

**Translations still need doing:** AGENTS.md says to run `pnpm i18n` after adding English strings. It needed a permission approval that wasn't given, so I skipped it. The other language files don't have the new keys yet. To fix it, either run `pnpm i18n` yourself (it sends the strings to Lingo.dev and needs its key in `.env`) or let Lingo.dev's commit hook translate them.

**Your call:** I included every membership the user has, without filtering on the membership's `accepted` flag. Tell me if pending memberships should be left out of the file.
